title: My registration is expired
text: You can still sell us a car with an expired registration, and it doesn't change the offer. Bring the expired registration card anyway. The exception is Brevin: there, the registration must be current on the day of the sale, so renew it before your appointment. If the car is registered in a different state from the one you live in, see [Selling a car registered in another state](kb:out_of_state).

title: What to do with your license plates
text: Remove your license plates before you hand over the car, and keep them. What you do with them afterward is up to your state's motor vehicle agency: you can usually transfer them to your next car.

title: What to do with your license plates
text: What happens to your plates depends on the state that issued them, not the state you live in. Aldora, Corlan and Dunmore plates: remove them and keep them. Brevin plates: leave them on the car; in Brevin, plates stay with the vehicle. Eastvale plates: remove them and return them to the Eastvale motor vehicle agency within 10 days; we give you the plate return receipt, form NW-PLT-1, which shows the car was sold. If you moved and the car is registered in another state, see [Selling a car registered in another state](kb:out_of_state).

title: When to cancel your insurance
text: Keep your car insured until the sale is complete and the car is in our hands, including on the day of a home pickup. Cancel your policy, or remove the car from it, only after you sign the paperwork. Ask your insurer about a refund for the unused part of your premium. Before you hand over the car, also remove toll tags and personal data ([Toll tags, garage codes and paired phones](kb:toll_tags_personal_data)).

title: Toll tags, garage codes and paired phones
text: Before you sell, remove toll tags and parking stickers, clear garage door codes, and unpair your phone from the car's system. If the car has a connected-car app, remove the car from your account so the next owner can't see your data. To delete the personal data Northwind holds about you, see [Deleting your Northwind account](kb:account_deletion).

title: Selling a car registered in another state
text: We buy cars registered in any state we serve, even if you now live in a different one. Bring the registration from the state that issued it. In Brevin, a car registered in another state needs an emissions certificate from a Brevin inspection station before we can buy it at a Brevin store. If the title is lost, the duplicate rules of the state that issued it apply ([Selling a paid-off car when the title is lost](kb:lost_title)).

text: We buy cars registered in any state we serve, even if you now live in a different one. Bring the registration from the state that issued it.
